item.title: IID Prophet Inequalities
item.description: Last week I had the pleasure of seeing Nikhil Devanur present Static pricing for multi-unit prophet inequalities, which is joint with Thodoris Lykouris and Shuchi Chawla. I greatly enjoyed the paper, and discussed it in a blog post last week. Today, I will go beyond what is in their paper to tackle a question asked by my colleague Will Ma. 1 Setting the Stage The original paper considers a setting where we are presented with a sequence of values.
